description: APPLICATION FOR RETENTION OF HIP TO GABLE AND REAR DORMER ROOF EXTENSION AND ALTERATIONS TO FRONT AND REAR EAVES.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The existing as built rear dormer roof extension by reason of its combined siting, design and use of incongruous materials at roof level fails to achieve a high standard of design resulting in an unsympathetic and incongruous form of development that fails to relate to the character, appearance, form and proportion of the host dwelling and the semi-detached pair and would appear out of keeping in the localised context and would negatively detract from the character of the surrounding dwellings. Therefore, the existing as built dormer is contrary to, in particular, National Planning Policy Framework Chapters 4 and 12, London Plan 2021 policies D3 and D4,  Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.1, D12.2, D12.3 and D12.4.

Reason : 2 - The existing eaves of the rear dormer roof extension by reason of its combined siting and design including the extended eaves, the eaves overhang and the removal of eaves along the middle of the dormer would fail to align with the eaves of the adjoining semi-detached dwelling and therefore results in an unsympathetic and incongruous form of development that fails to relate to the character, appearance, form and proportion of the host dwelling and the semi-detached pair and would appear out of keeping in the localised context and would negatively detract from the character of the surrounding dwellings. Therefore, the existing as built dormer is contrary to, in particular, National Planning Policy Framework Chapters 4 and 12, London Plan 2021 policies D3 and D4,  Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.1, D12.2, D12.3 and D12.4.

Reason : 3 - The dormer window design and use of large expanse glaze panel at roof level appears overbearing, out of proportion, unsympathetic and out of keeping with the appearance and character of the original building, the semi-detached pair and the surrounding dwellings in the locality contrary to, in particular, National Planning Policy Framework Chapters 4 and 12, London Plan 2021 policies D3 and D4,  Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.1, D12.2, D12.3 and D12.4.

Reason : 4 - In the absence of accurate drawings reflecting the extended front eaves, the scheme has not satisfactorily demonstrated it will safeguard the evident symmetry between the host site and the adjoining semi-detached pair and the visual amenity of the locality.  The scheme is contrary to, in particular, National Planning Policy Framework Chapters 4 and 12, London Plan 2021 policies D3 and D4,  Merton Local Plan 2024 policies D12.1, D12.2, D12.3 and D12.4.

Reason : 5 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the NPPF, The London Borough of Merton  (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to development proposals focused on solutions. LBM works with applicants/agents in a positive and proactive manner by:
"	Offering a pre-application advice and duty desk service. 
"	Where possible, suggesting solutions to secure a successful outcome.
"	As appropriate, updating applicants/agents of any issues that may arise in the processing of their application.
In this instance:
"	The application was considered to be fundamentally contrary to the provisions of the Development Plan and the NPPF, and there were not considered to be any solutions to resolve this conflict. 
"	It is noted that the applicant/agent did not engage in any pre-application discussions.
"	The applicant is advised to seek pre-application advice on any resubmission.

Reason : 6 - INFORMATIVE
The applicants are informed that accurate drawings are required to be submitted with any application.
